title: A September Picnic
setting: A sunny park with green grass in September.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue t-shirt

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily, a young girl with long black hair and a red dress

sentences.en: Mia and Sam begin a picnic in September.
sentences.zh: 九月，米娅和萨姆开始野餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue t-shirt spread a picnic blanket on green grass in a park with a few early autumn leaves.

sentences.en: Mia brings forty small chocolates and cool drinks.
sentences.zh: 米娅带来了四十块小巧克力和清凉的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt opens a box full of small chocolates next to cold drinks on the blanket.

sentences.en: Sam sees something in the middle of the grass.
sentences.zh: 萨姆看见草地中间有个东西。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue t-shirt points at something small in the middle of the grass.

sentences.en: Maybe it is a lost pet.
sentences.zh: 也许它是一只走丢的宠物。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue t-shirt look curiously at a small animal shape in the grass.

sentences.en: It is a puppy the size of a shoe.
sentences.zh: 那是一只只有鞋子大小的小狗。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tiny puppy, as small as a shoe, sits on the grass in front of Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue t-shirt.

sentences.en: Lily runs over, too happy to say anything.
sentences.zh: 莉莉跑过来，高兴得说不出话。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a young girl with long black hair and a red dress runs across the grass toward the puppy with a big happy face.

sentences.en: She never wants to lose her puppy again.
sentences.zh: 她再也不想弄丢她的小狗了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a young girl with long black hair and a red dress hugs the tiny puppy tightly.

sentences.en: Sharing chocolate with her is an easy thing.
sentences.zh: 和她分享巧克力是件很容易的事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a blue t-shirt give chocolates to Lily, a young girl with long black hair and a red dress on the picnic blanket, the puppy beside them.
